## Two Related Bugs — Same Root Cause: Missing Provenance Envelope

Observed on the live newssite at :8082:

> "James Bell Re-Elected with Strong Backing at AAPL  
> AAPL — 30 May 2026  
> By the Entity-Graph Desk  
> Director approval at 98.3% meets high-trust threshold (>95%)."

The filing is from 2019 (accession 0000320193-19-000032). The date shown is today. This is a credibility-destroying bug at scale.

---

### Bug #1 — Date Presentation

The newssite stamps articles with `published_date` (when entity-graph processed the filing) instead of `filing_date` (when the 8-K was filed with the SEC). Every historical filing backfilled during ticker onboarding will appear as today's news.

At scale this means:
- Onboarding a new ticker with 5 years of 8-K history floods the front page with fa

suggested_fix:
Fix in this sequence:

1. internal/provenance/envelope.go FIRST — define the canonical struct once, import everywhere. This is the foundation.
2. internal/entitygraph/signals.go — populate provenance.filing_date from the 8-K accession metadata at signal write time. The accession number already encodes the date (XXXXXXXXXX-YY-NNNNNN where YY is year) — parse it.
